title: Stakeholder Map — round wheel on phones and tablets

changes.note: phones/tablets: square, centred wheel canvas in the page flow; note above the wheel, not over it
wheel drawing sized from the canvas box, not the 560px map box (root cause of the ellipse and mis-aimed taps)
changes.new: const box=cv.getBoundingClientRect();   // size the drawing to the canvas's own box so the wheel stays round (phones show it as a square)

changes.note: wheel redrawn whenever the canvas box changes size
changes.new:
window.addEventListener('resize',resize);
if(window.ResizeObserver){let _cw=0,_ch=0;new ResizeObserver(function(){const b=cv.getBoundingClientRect(),w=Math.round(b.width),h=Math.round(b.height);if(w&&(w!==_cw||h!==_ch)){_cw=w;_ch=h;resize();}}).observe(cv);}   // redraw when the canvas box itself changes size

changes.note: square canvas keeps a proportional margin so the outer region labels are not cut off at 768px; desktop radius unchanged
changes.new: CX=W/2;CY=H/2;R=Math.max(20,Math.min(W,H)/2-(W<H*1.1?Math.max(34,Math.min(W,H)*0.1):34));draw();   // square canvas (phones/tablets): leave room for the region labels

changes.note: selected-company ring no longer throws "DKM is not defined" (tap-to-select redraws again)
